findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compare-tariffs, start-booking · Private data: start-booking, compare-vpn, book-contract, submit-switch-request · Public sink: book-contract, submit-switch-request · Destructive: compare-tariffs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compare-tariffs, start-booking · Private data: start-booking, compare-vpn, book-contract, submit-switch-request · Public sink: book-contract, submit-switch-request · Destructive: compare-tariffs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
